cashbox_daily_ledger_ai.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "cashbox_daily_ledger_ai" AFTER INSERT ON "ledger_entries"
WHEN COALESCE(NEW."status", 'active') = 'active' AND NEW."cash_impact" IN ('in', 'out')
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "cashbox_daily_balances" ("tenant_id", "currency", "balance_date", "closing_balance", "updated_at")
  SELECT NEW."tenant_id", NEW."currency", NEW."date",
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT c."closing_balance" FROM "cashbox_daily_balances" c
             WHERE c."tenant_id" = NEW."tenant_id" AND c."currency" = NEW."currency" AND c."balance_date" < NEW."date"
             ORDER BY c."balance_date" DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT COALESCE(s."opening_balance", 0) FROM "cashbox_sessions" s
             WHERE s."tenant_id" = NEW."tenant_id" AND s."currency" = NEW."currency" LIMIT 1),
           0) + (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END),
         COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'))
   WHERE (1) AND (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END) <> 0
  ON CONFLICT ("tenant_id", "currency", "balance_date") DO UPDATE SET
    "closing_balance" = "closing_balance" + (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END),
    "updated_at" = COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'));
  UPDATE "cashbox_daily_balances"
     SET "closing_balance" = "closing_balance" + (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END), "updated_at" = COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'))
   WHERE (1) AND (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN NEW."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN (COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) ELSE -(COALESCE(NEW."debit", 0) + COALESCE(NEW."credit", 0)) END) <> 0
     AND "tenant_id" = NEW."tenant_id" AND "currency" = NEW."currency" AND "balance_date" > NEW."date";
END

cashbox_daily_ledger_au.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "cashbox_daily_ledger_au" AFTER UPDATE OF "status", "cash_impact", "debit", "credit" ON "ledger_entries"
WHEN NOT COALESCE((OLD."cash_impact" NOT IN ('in', 'out') AND NEW."cash_impact" NOT IN ('in', 'out')), 0)
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "cashbox_daily_balances" ("tenant_id", "currency", "balance_date", "closing_balance", "updated_at")
  SELECT OLD."tenant_id", OLD."currency", OLD."date",
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT c."closing_balance" FROM "cashbox_daily_balances" c
             WHERE c."tenant_id" = OLD."tenant_id" AND c."currency" = OLD."currency" AND c."balance_date" < OLD."date"
             ORDER BY c."balance_date" DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT COALESCE(s."opening_balance", 0) FROM "cashbox_sessions" s
             WHERE s."tenant_id" = OLD."tenant_id" AND s."currency" = OLD."currency" LIMIT 1),
           0) + (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END),
         COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'))
   WHERE (COALESCE(OLD."status", 'active') = 'active' AND COALESCE(NEW."status", 'active') = 'cancelled' AND OLD."cash_impact" IN ('in', 'out')) AND (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END) <> 0
  ON CONFLICT ("tenant_id", "currency", "balance_date") DO UPDATE SET
    "closing_balance" = "closing_balance" + (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END),
    "updated_at" = COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'));
  UPDATE "cashbox_daily_balances"
     SET "closing_balance" = "closing_balance" + (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END), "updated_at" = COALESCE((SELECT "ts" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'))
   WHERE (COALESCE(OLD."status", 'active') = 'active' AND COALESCE(NEW."status", 'active') = 'cancelled' AND OLD."cash_impact" IN ('in', 'out')) AND (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN OLD."cash_impact" = 'in' THEN -(COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) ELSE (COALESCE(OLD."debit", 0) + COALESCE(OLD."credit", 0)) END) <> 0
     AND "tenant_id" = OLD."tenant_id" AND "currency" = OLD."currency" AND "balance_date" > OLD."date";
  INSERT INTO "cashbox_daily_balances" ("tenant_id", "currency", "balance_date", "closing_balance", "updated_at")
  SELECT NEW."tenant_id", NEW."currency", NEW."date",
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT c."closing_balance" FROM "cashbox_daily_balances" c
             WHERE c."tenant_id" = NEW."tenant_id" AND c."currency" = NEW."currency" AND c."balance_date" < NEW."date"

trg_ledger_entries_append_only_bd.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ledger_entries_append_only_bd" BEFORE DELETE ON "ledger_entries"
WHEN COALESCE((SELECT "allow_dye_purge" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), 0) = 0
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entries is append-only: DELETE not allowed');
END

trg_ledger_entries_append_only_bu.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ledger_entries_append_only_bu" BEFORE UPDATE ON "ledger_entries"
WHEN NOT COALESCE((COALESCE((SELECT "allow_party_remap" FROM "motard_tx_state" WHERE "id" = 1), 0) = 1
       AND NEW."debit" = OLD."debit" AND NEW."credit" = OLD."credit" AND NEW."currency" = OLD."currency"
       AND NEW."date" = OLD."date" AND NEW."type" = OLD."type" AND NEW."status" = OLD."status"
       AND NEW."reference_id" IS OLD."reference_id" AND NEW."reference_type" IS OLD."reference_type"), 0)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entries: cannot modify already-cancelled rows') WHERE OLD."status" = 'cancelled';
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entries: UPDATE only allowed for cancellation (status→cancelled)') WHERE NEW."status" <> 'cancelled';
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entries: financial columns are immutable') WHERE NEW."debit" <> OLD."debit" OR NEW."credit" <> OLD."credit"
       OR NEW."currency" <> OLD."currency" OR NEW."party_id" <> OLD."party_id"
       OR NEW."date" <> OLD."date" OR NEW."type" <> OLD."type"
       OR NEW."reference_id" IS NOT OLD."reference_id"
       OR NEW."reference_type" IS NOT OLD."reference_type";
END

trg_sync_inbox_applied_seq_ai.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_sync_inbox_applied_seq_ai" AFTER INSERT ON "sync_inbox"
WHEN NEW."status" = 'applied'
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "motard_sequences" ("name", "value") VALUES ('sync_inbox_applied_seq', 1)
    ON CONFLICT ("name") DO UPDATE SET "value" = "value" + 1;
  UPDATE "sync_inbox"
     SET "applied_seq" = (SELECT "value" FROM "motard_sequences" WHERE "name" = 'sync_inbox_applied_seq'),
         "applied_at" = COALESCE("applied_at", (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now') || '000Z'))
   WHERE "id" = NEW."id";
END

    ON CONFLICT ("name") DO UPDATE SET "value" = "value" + 1;
  UPDATE "sync_inbox"
     SET "applied_seq" = (SELECT "value" FROM "motard_sequences" WHERE "name" = 'sync_inbox_applied_seq'),
